top_signals.title: Transportation committee in House set for overhaul post-election
top_signals.summary:
The massive Democratic Party win on Election Day will have implications for government rules and regulations on trucking, including the so-called highway bill, driven in part by changes in the lineups of who will sit on Congress’ transportation-focused committees. There are several members of the House Transportation & Infrastructure (T&I) committee who won’t be around […]
